### Describe the Bug

Running `next build` ignores the `moduleResolution` field if it contains a value other than `nodejs`, even when using a permitted type as outlined here:

https://github.com/vercel/next.js/blob/d895a50abbc8f91726daa2d7ebc22c58f58aabbb/packages/next/lib/typescript/writeConfigurationDefaults.ts#L59-L61

This means that builds that pass direct type checking via `tsc` will fail to build if `node12` or `nodenext` are used.

I did a bit of digging and it appears this is because while [writeConfigurationDefaults](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/blob/e57e2753f12076a99173a80787e6d1a2cdb3a0fc/packages/next/lib/verifyTypeScriptSetup.ts#L71) allows  `parsedValues` options above, `getRequiredConfiguration` only returns `parsedValue` and which overrides the user's config:

https://github.com/vercel/next.js/blob/0d80b113a3d17ba86b273c8d7cef7a7a20cde95b/packages/next/lib/typescript/runTypeCheck.ts#L39-L47

If this is not the expected behavior I'm happy to attempt a PR to fix, but wanted to confirm before giving it a shot.

### Expected Behavior

Running `yarn build` should respect the `moduleResolution` field when it contains a permitted value other than `nodejs`.

### Link to reproduction

https://stackblitz.com/edit/vercel-next-js-wtfonr

### To Reproduce

Run `yarn build` (and also observe that `yarn tsc` does not error)
